title: Mixed Event — Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas — Episode5 For Me To Draw It Right

meta.Event: Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas
meta.Episode: Episode5 — For Me To Draw It Right
meta.Event Outline: Ena decides to go back to her former art class, but her teacher, Mr. Yukihira, tells her that her drawing lacks appeal. Meanwhile, Honami feels anxious about job shadowing, tasked with teaching a subject she struggles with...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Okay, good...
She's tracing it just fine.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honami seems to get nervous when she's told to draw whatever she likes. Meanwhile...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhum♪
Smiles all around♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's done!
Ena, can you take a look?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sure, let's see...
Oh, is this Phenny...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's really cute.
Are those balloons in his hands?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! He's going for a walk around Phoenix Wonderland and giving balloons to all of the visitors he meets☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
How's my drawing, Ena?!
Do you think children would smile when they see it?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I wouldn't worry. I bet your drawing can make anyone smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but I'm supposed to teach and not just draw. I'm still not too sure how that's gonna go...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
You came here to learn more about teaching others.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Well, you'll be teaching little kids, so showering them with praise first might be important.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Praising them?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Looking for what they do well and complimenting them by saying things like, “Oh, that's so wonderful,” or, “You drew it so well,” could work.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And then gently give them some advice when you see something that you think they should fix.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gently giving them advice...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, so... I'm not very good at giving others advice...! Is there something I can do about that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
How about we try practicing that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll draw something for you right now, so why don't you give me some advice regarding it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ena, I've finished tracing it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Great!
Yeah, that's some nice tracing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I never imagined myself drawing these lines so well...!
I sort of can't believe it...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really glad.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you can do this, then I think we can get you to pick a photo and draw exactly what's in it. Let's try it out!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was worried for a second there, but things seem to be working out pretty well.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(A lot of time's already passed.
I wonder how Honami's doing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Whoa...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Sh-She's drawing another black blob!
Wh-Why...?!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: E-Ena...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wh-Why does this always happen...?
I was able to trace so well but this is...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That's what I want to know!!!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: G-Gimme a sec to think...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hmm... She was doing fine just now. How did she go from that to this?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There's nothing actually wrong with her style, so she could conceivably just stick with this and...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, that wouldn't help with her problem. That's not why she's here...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Am I just not cut out for this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If this is the best I can do, maybe I should give up and be Emu's assistant instead...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At this rate, Honami's never going to be able to draw the way she wants...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To be fair, there have been times when I wanted to run because things got so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But it's too much of a waste...
Art's supposed to be about having fun while drawing...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I need to teach Honami in a way that lets her do just that while building up her confidence. What's a nice, simple style that anyone can learn...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I got it.
Let's get you to memorize simple shapes so you can draw things more cartoonishly!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In other words, you draw in a way that exaggerates a subject's most prominent features. For example, a cat has a round head with triangular ears...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Like this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's really cute...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: From what I've seen, Honami, you have no trouble drawing geometric shapes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, wouldn't it be easier to break things down into their individual parts? A circle for its face, triangles for its ears, and so on and so forth...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...!
I'll give that a try!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A circle for its face... Triangles for its ears...! And I'll draw a couple of lines on each side of the circle...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I did it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Emu, mind taking a look at what Honami drew for me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me?
Wow! Your cat's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
R-Really? You can tell that it's a cat?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
It's a kitty cat with a cute, round face☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honami finally smiled.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Next, let's try drawing a bear!
A circle for its face and a pair of small circles for its ears... Like this, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... How's this?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, perfect! Nice job!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Th-Thank you very much!
I don't know what else to say!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's keep this up and keep drawing more animals. Our next one will be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I... I did it!
Which animal does this look like to you...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... A triangular face with triangular ears... It's a fox!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
C-Correct!
You got them all...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Good work, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is the first time anyone's been able to guess what I drew...! I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And it's been a pleasure to teach you.
Hehe. You've made some huge strides since your first drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. How about I keep your first one as a little souvenir?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wh-What?!
No, it's okay if you just tossed it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really like the way you draw, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I especially like the way you made your first drawing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I kinda want to frame it and hang it up. Like the painting we have downstairs☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it has this really abstract feel, so it might actually look really nice in a frame.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We can hang it up next to Remidle's painting! Can you draw something for me?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Wait, hanging my drawing up next to that Remidle painting doesn't seem like a good idea...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ena, Honami!
Thank you both for coming today!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thank you for inviting us.
Your shadowing's next weekend, right? I wish you both the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, we really appreciate it.
I should be able to do just fine thanks to you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll tell you all about what we drew afterwards!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
I'll be looking forward to hearing about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, Emu, see you again at school.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! Get home safe!
Bye bye!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Once again, thank you very much for today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For teaching me how to draw, making my art easily recognizable and praising me the way you did... I really appreciate everything you did.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'm really glad you're saying that since I can't exactly say that I'm good enough to be teaching...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I learned to have some confidence in my artistic skills. So, Ena, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. In that case, I'm really glad.
So, good luck with your shadowing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm this way. We'll have to part ways here. Again, Ena, thank you for today!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure thing. Bye bye.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay...
A lot happened, but I somehow managed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And they said that they're visiting that kindergarten next weekend... I really hope their shadowing goes well...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, Honami's drawing really packed a punch. I don't think I'm ever going to forget what I saw...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Actually, I kinda want to take another look at it.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Yeah, this is really something else...
I can't make heads or tails of what she was trying to draw, but it feels compelling for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Wait, this drawing...
At first, I had no idea what this was...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I'm starting to see an elephant and its individual parts! Now I get it, Honami...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This must be its ears... Here's its nose... It probably wasn't intentional, but the way she drew everything is really interesting.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, and here's its face...
Is it smiling...? I couldn't tell initially because of how this drawing looks overall...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honami actually drew something nice, but her drawing quirks made that a bit hard to see...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I need to teach Honami in a way that lets her do just that while building up her confidence. What's a nice, simple style that anyone can learn...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: From what I've seen, Honami, you have no trouble drawing geometric shapes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, wouldn't it be easier to break things down into their individual parts? A circle for its face, triangles for its ears, and so on and so forth...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I especially like the way you made your first drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did the way I teach actually help...?
